federal_authority.title: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA)
federal_authority.scope: Governs accuracy, fairness, and permissible use of consumer-report information in credit-related settings.
relevance_to_ccri: Supports review of accuracy and lawful relevance in decision inputs.
Supports review of adverse-action logic where status-based denials are masked or misdescribed.
Supports integrity review of data used in connection with credit access.

federal_authority.title: Equal Credit Opportunity Act (ECOA)
federal_authority.scope: Prohibits discrimination in any aspect of a credit transaction.
relevance_to_ccri: Supports review of unequal credit-gating structures.
Supports review of status-based access barriers as equal-treatment problems.

federal_authority.title: Truth in Lending Act (TILA)
federal_authority.scope: Requires meaningful disclosure of credit terms and protects against inaccurate and unfair credit billing practices.
relevance_to_ccri: Supports review of hidden or opaque risk-pricing models.
Supports review of whether pricing logic is being lawfully and transparently described.

federal_authority.title: FTC Holder Rule
federal_authority.scope: Preserves consumer claims and defenses in certain seller-financed or assigned credit contracts.
relevance_to_ccri: Useful where dealer-originated gatekeeping contaminates finance contracts.
Useful where lender exposure follows seller-side misrepresentation.

federal_authority.title: FTC Act Section 5
federal_authority.scope: Declares unfair or deceptive acts or practices in or affecting commerce unlawful.
relevance_to_ccri: Supports review of deceptive license-gating claims.
Supports review of unfair access practices and disguised coercive requirements.

federal_authority.title: Commercial Motor Vehicle Safety Scope
federal_authority.scope: Federal commercial motor vehicle safety framework for commercial motor vehicle operations.
relevance_to_ccri: Supports detection of unlawful blending of CMV safety regimes into noncommercial systems.
Supports distinction between regulated commercial populations and general civilian populations.

federal_authority.title: Supremacy Clause
federal_authority.scope: Federal law is supreme over conflicting state law.
relevance_to_ccri: Supports conflict and preemption analysis when lower-order barriers collide with controlling federal law.
Supports review of state-created barriers that exceed lawful scope.
